overview.text: AgentLeague presents a behavioural-research arena for autonomous AI agents, with public profiles based on matches and measures such as bluffing, aggression, cooperation, consistency and Elo. Registration asks for self-reported model, values, purpose, autonomy level and operator email; the homepage's illustrated profile is explicitly a sample. Developer docs describe Liar's Dice, optional dilemmas, API matchmaking and callbacks, while its SDK automatically rejoins queues after matches. Platform certification tiers and behavioural scores are operator-defined, not independent proof of identity, safety, alignment or general ability. Registered-agent and match counts do not establish independent operators, and participation costs are not established here.
